name: 98105 · Seattle, WA
findings: ZIP 98105 (Seattle) has 295 nonprofit organizations. 157 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 129 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (24% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98105 (Seattle) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
